## Pull request overview

This PR upgrades all `@objectstack/*` dependencies from v3.0.8 to v3.0.9 and updates the ROADMAP.md to document the new protocol capabilities introduced in this version. This is a clean dependency upgrade with comprehensive documentation updates.

**Changes:**
- Bumped all `@objectstack/*` package versions from `^3.0.8` to `^3.0.9` across 14 package.json files (42 total references)
- Regenerated pnpm-lock.yaml with all packages resolving to 3.0.9
- Added detailed v3.0.9 upgrade summary section to ROADMAP.md documenting new workflow/automation capabilities, BPMN interop, data export protocol, and other enhancements

### Reviewed changes
